audit_items.proof_trace: ADL triggering requires admin-gated activation (AdminCap), a 3-day timelock, protocol-level threshold enforcement via ensure_limit_breached (adl.move:215-216), and a PackageCallerCap with adl() permission granted only by admin — satisfying the 'extreme conditions' requirement. Position selection fairness relies on the trusted-keeper model: only whitelisted executors with admin-granted ADL permission can call liquidate_adl_borrow/deposit, and ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed verifies each selected obligation's LTV exceeds the ADL threshold (market.move:964-970), ensuring only genuinely unhealthy positions are targeted. The absence of on-chain position ordering is an intentional design tradeoff consistent with the protocol's permissioned-executor architecture.
